github_surges.description: The Super Game Agent — the Unity & Unreal for AI agents, with 100+ viral games to remix. Turn 20+ coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, etc.) into a full-stack AI game studio. Build and publish 3D & mini-games to WeChat, Douyin, TikTok, Telegram, itch.io, and more.
Qwen3-0.6B inference (12 KB), bare-metal bootable OS (22 KB), and from-scratch Mini-GPT trainer with live Braille TUI (32 KB) in 100% pure x86-64 NASM assembly. Zero C, zero libc, zero dependencies.

Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile your app, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same. Python, JS/TS, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Go, PHP, C/C++, C#, R.
Agent skill to build games, interactive scenes, web pages and animations in a handcrafted pop-up papercraft style
Your AI agents, live on a pixel-art stage. Works with Claude Code.

Robotics agent skills (MuJoCo, perception, planning, sim2real, bring-up) for Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and more. Adapted from google-deepmind/robotics-antigravity-plugin (Apache-2.0).
Agent skill: turn four pixel art views into fake-3D sprites you can spin. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Pi.
Biosignal-guided reinforcement learning for LLM agents: offline organoid neural recordings as policy inputs in a Godot survival game, with paired evaluation.
A small desktop robot with LLM-based interactions and reinforcement learning capabilities that you can train to act as you want. And it can remember you！

Detection rules and IOCs for AI agent attack frameworks: ARTEX, Cairn, PentAGI, HexStrike, CyberStrikeAI, Strix, Hermes Agent, Agent Zero, RedAmon, Xalgorix, Pentest Swarm AI. KQL hunts for Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR, Sigma, Suricata, Zeek, YARA, Splunk, Elastic, STIX 2.1.
